voci.azione: Exit Claude Code. Press twice within 800ms to confirm (app:exit)
Toggle visibility of Claude's to-do checklist. This is not the /tasks background-task view (app:toggleTodos)
Force a full screen redraw, preserving input and conversation (chat:clearInput)
Same as chat:clearInput. See Clear the conversation for how Cmd+K behaves on iTerm2 (chat:clearScreen)

Stop all running background subagents in this session and turn off artifact auto-replies for the rest of it. Press the shortcut twice within 3 seconds to confirm. You can press it while a background subagent's permission prompt is open (chat:killAgents)

Submit the message, marked to wait its turn: while Claude is working, Claude Code queues it and never interrupts the turn. Unlike chat:submit, it submits the draft even while an autocomplete suggestion is highlighted. Requires v2.1.247 or later (chat:queueSubmit)

Send your queued messages, and your draft with them, right away. When Claude Code sends what you queued covers what happens to the turn Claude is working on. When nothing is running, the key submits the draft, and in shell mode it only queues the command. Terminals that don't report extended keys deliver Ctrl+Enter as plain Enter, so Ctrl+X Ctrl+S is the binding that works in any terminal. Requires v2.1.275 or later (chat:sendNow)

Send your queued messages, and your draft with them, right away. When Claude Code sends what you queued covers what happens to the turn Claude is working on. When nothing is running, the key submits the draft, and in shell mode it only queues the command. Terminals that don't report extended keys deliver Ctrl+Enter as plain Enter, so Ctrl+X Ctrl+S is the binding that works in any terminal. Requires v2.1.275 or later (chat:sendNow)
Open in external editor. The agent view dispatch input follows this action's single-keystroke bindings too (chat:externalEditor)
Open in external editor. The agent view dispatch input follows this action's single-keystroke bindings too (chat:externalEditor)
Paste image from clipboard. On WSL, both shortcuts are bound by default (chat:imagePaste)
In the /fast dialog, turn fast mode on or off (confirm:nextField)

On a file permission prompt, closes an open comment field; with no field open, selects the option that allows the action for the rest of the session, when the prompt offers that option (confirm:cycleMode)
Navigate up in footer (deselects at top) (footer:up)
Navigate up in footer (deselects at top) (footer:up)
Stop the selected agent or workflow, or dismiss its row if it's no longer running (footer:close)
Close diff viewer; from the detail view, returns to the file list instead (diff:dismiss)
Previous file in the file list; scroll up one line in the detail view (diff:previousFile)

Next file in the file list; scroll down one line in the detail view (diff:nextFile)
